Description: This recall involves Peony Design personalized handmade baby bibs and stroller bags.
Title: Peony Design Recalls Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard
ConsumerContact: Peony Design by email at peonydesigncoshoppe@gmail.com for more information.

Products.Name: Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags

Manufacturers.Name: Peony Design Co., of Howell, MI

Hazards.Name: The snap can detach from the recalled bibs and stroller bags, posing a choking hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled products and contact Peony Design for a refund.

Description: This recall involves Thule Sleek strollers.
Title: Thule Recalls Strollers Due to Injury Hazard

Hazards.Name: The stroller's handlebar can detach, posing an injury hazard to children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled strollers and contact Thule Group for a replacement.
